reuse.why: Uses the existing db helpers and adds one guard; there was no pre-existing link guard or shared link sequence to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule lives in one function; only its call is repeated in each of the five provider link functions, which themselves are pre-existing copies.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link functions and runs before bank lookup or any write.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clear named guard with an explicit query; a new provider must remember to call it because linking itself is not shared.

one_place.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in server/accounts/app.ts, called first by all five link*Account functions (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu, Enable Banking).
